i.norm: Tests {@link StrMatcher#quoteMatcher()}, which matches a single (') or double (") quote character.

A buffer whose final three characters exercise the quote matcher. Reading the characters out by index:
  • index 10 = the NUL character (�) - not a quote
  • index 11 = a single quote (')
  • index 12 = a double quote (")
(Earlier indices hold assorted digits and whitespace that the quote matcher is never asked about here.)
A match consumes one character; a non-match consumes none.
quoteMatcher() returns the same shared, cached instance every time.
